title: The Festival Newsroom
learning_focus: Informational text; outlining; explanation/news/persuasive purpose; fact, opinion, and fact-based opinion; generalization; propaganda awareness; formal tone.
story_premise: Competing reports about a regional event create confusion. Some use glittering words, testimonials, or fear instead of evidence.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Informational text; outlining; explanation/news/persuasive purpose; fact, opinion, and fact-based opinion; generalization; propaganda awareness; formal tone.
